regions.text: 华二章假說伪偶然第一の場合に屬するものは、例へば機械親的決定論の牛面として宇宙の全後に目々偶然性が主張される如き場合である。

quote.translation: To the first case belongs, for example, the assertion of teleological contingency for the universe as a whole, as the other half of a mechanistic determinism.

regions.text: この場合には、目約々偶然の観念が因果必然との異種結合によつて存在の全面に亙つて適用されてゐる。

quote.translation: Here the idea of teleological contingency, in heterogeneous combination with causal necessity, is applied across the whole of existence.

regions.text: 例へばラメトリイの人間機械論にあらはれてるる。『人間は恐らく偶然に地球の表面の何處か一點へ投げ出されたものである。..！

quote.translation: We find it, for instance, in La Mettrie's L'Homme machine: "Man has perhaps been thrown by chance onto some point or other of the surface of the earth.

regions.text: 所で況神論者は質間を後する。
間を後する。然らば、偶然と

quote.translation: Now the pantheist asks a question.

regions.text: 然らば、偶然とは偶然がその作者であると考へられてゐる多くの作品を、斯くの如く自分の滕手に變化せしめ、而も斯くの如き多様性もそれが同一目に達することを妨げ得ない、と云ふ程の大幾何學者なのであらうか？

quote.translation: Is chance, then, so great a geometer that it varies at its own pleasure, in this way, the many works of which chance is thought to be the author, and yet such variety cannot prevent them from attaining the same end?

regions.text: ....これは確に或る神の存在に對して云ひ得る最も有利なことのすべてである。

quote.translation: This is certainly all the most favourable things that can be said for the existence of a God.

regions.text: だが無神論者は同じ位に強い而も絶對に正反對のものを勤抗せしめることが出來るのである。

quote.translation: But the atheist can oppose to it things equally strong and absolutely contrary.

regions.text: 蓋し更感自然科學者の云ふ所を聽くならば彼等はかう云ふであらう。

quote.translation: For if we listen further to what the natural scientists say, they will say this.

regions.text: 化學者の手に於て種々なる偶然の混合に依って、最初の鏡を作つた同じ原因は自然の手に於ては澄んだ水を作りこれは唯名もない羊飼の女の役に立つてゐる。

quote.translation: The same cause that, in the hands of the chemist, through various chance mixtures, made the first mirror, made, in the hands of nature, clear water, and this serves merely a nameless shepherdess.

regions.text: .....鏡や水が人が姿を寫すことが出來るやうに作ら

quote.translation: That mirrors and water are not made so that people can reflect their figures in them is no different from all other bodies with smooth surfaces that have the same property.
